name: Kyoudai Dousei
source:
Main character's father remarries, so protagonist gets a new mother and sister. First impression of step-sister was a quiet crybaby. But both parents die in a traffic incident, so protagonist has to take care of her, and distance decreases. Is step-sister really an important relative now?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的父亲再婚后，他有了新的母亲和妹妹。初见时，继妹给他的印象是个安静的爱哭鬼。然而，父母双双在交通事故中去世，主人公不得不照顾她，两人的距离也逐渐拉近。如今，继妹真的已经成为他重要的家人了吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
